title: Help and support
description: Find an answer or send a request while limiting shared data.
noResultBody: Clear the search or contact support.

articles.accountBody: Manage sign-in and account deletion from settings.
articles.dataBody: You control memory. Review, correct, or delete every memory.
articles.subscriptionBody: Nexelf Pro purchases are managed and restored through the App Store or Google Play.
articles.aiBody: Nexelf suggests, but runs no action and adds nothing to memory without confirmation.

reportHint: The response content is not attached and this report is not added to memory.
privacyWarning: Never share a password, token, payment card, medical data, or identity document.
subject: Subject
messagePlaceholder: Describe the issue without sensitive data
draftRestored: Your private draft was restored on this device.
diagnosticOptional: Optional and off by default. You can send your request without it.
diagnosticDetails: Shared data: Nexelf version, platform, system version, and language. No message, history, contacts, location, photos, tokens, or full logs.
successBody: The request was recorded. This does not confirm that a person has read it yet.

errors.generic: Sending failed. Your draft is kept; check your connection and try again.
errors.rate: Too many requests were sent recently. Your draft is kept; try again later.
errors.forbidden: Sign in again to contact support. No information about the reported response was revealed.
